api.historyShape: (d N : Nat) : Shape := [spaceAxis d, timeAxis N]
api.historyCoord: {d N : Nat} (i : Fin d) (l : Fin (N + 1)) : Coord (historyShape d N)
api.Tensor: inductive Tensor | X | Z | H; deriving DecidableEq, Repr
api.declarations: (d N : Nat) : Declarations Unit; Tensor := Tensor; UIDs X=10, Z=11, H=12
api.RegisteredF.input_eq: (f : RegisteredF r d) : ∀ i, r.input f.op i = stateTy d
api.RegisteredF.output_eq: (f : RegisteredF r d) : r.output f.op = stateTy d
api.RegisteredF.total: (f : RegisteredF r d) : ∀ xs, r.domain f.op xs = true
api.RegisteredF.arguments: (f : RegisteredF r d) (x : State V d) : (i : Fin (r.arity f.op)) → Value (Carrier V) (r.input f.op i)
api.RegisteredF.transition: (f : RegisteredF r d) (x : State V d) : State V d
api.directRead: {W Γ : Type} {sh : Shape} (index : Γ → Coord sh) : AdmittedRead W sh Γ
api.RegisteredF.arrayExpr: {Γ : Type} {σ : Declarations Unit} (f : RegisteredF r d) (arg : Expr (Carrier V) σ r Γ (stateTy d)) : Expr (Carrier V) σ r Γ (stateTy d)
api.priorSlice: {Γ : Type} (l : Γ → Fin (N + 1)) : Expr (Carrier V) (declarations d N) r Γ (stateTy d)
api.recurrenceBody: {Γ : Type} (f : RegisteredF r d) (i : Γ → Fin d) (l : Γ → Fin (N + 1)) : Expr (Carrier V) (declarations d N) r Γ (.scalar ())
api.valuationPair: (d N : Nat) (v : Fin (d * (N + 1))) : Fin d × Fin (N + 1)
api.valuationIndex: {d N : Nat} (i : Fin d) (l : Fin (N + 1)) : Fin (d * (N + 1))
api.valuationPair_index: (i : Fin d) (l : Fin (N + 1)) : valuationPair d N (valuationIndex i l) = (i, l)
api.AdmittedValuation: (d N : Nat) (s : Fin 3) := {v : Fin (d * (N + 1)) // statementGuard d N s v = true}
api.recurrence_lt: (v : AdmittedValuation d N recurrenceID) : (valuationPair d N v.val).2.val < N
api.destination: (d N : Nat) (s : Fin 3) (v : AdmittedValuation d N s) : Coord (historyShape d N)
api.statementBody: (f : RegisteredF r d) (N : Nat) (s : Fin 3) : Expr (Carrier V) (declarations d N) r (AdmittedValuation d N s) (.scalar ())
api.isInput: : Tensor → Bool; true on X/Z, false on H
api.isOutput: : Tensor → Bool; false on X/Z, true on H
api.program: (f : RegisteredF r d) (N : Nat) : Program (Carrier V) (declarations d N) r
api.historyDefined: (f : RegisteredF r d) (N : Nat) : (program f N).Defined
api.historyAddress: (d N : Nat) (i : Fin d) (l : Fin (N + 1)) : Address (declarations d N)
api.historyDefAddr: (f : RegisteredF r d) (N : Nat) (i : Fin d) (l : Fin (N + 1)) : DefAddr (program f N)
api.persistentOccurrence: (f : RegisteredF r d) (N : Nat) (i : Fin d) (l : Fin (N + 1)) : (program f N).Occurrence (historyDefined f N)
api.initialOccurrence: (f : RegisteredF r d) (N : Nat) (i : Fin d) : (program f N).Occurrence (historyDefined f N)
api.recurrenceOccurrence: (f : RegisteredF r d) (N : Nat) (i : Fin d) (l : Fin N) : (program f N).Occurrence (historyDefined f N)
api.priorSlice_footprint: {Γ : Type} (l : Γ → Fin (N + 1)) (γ : Γ) : footprint (priorSlice (V := V) (r := r) (d := d) l) γ = (List.finRange d).map (fun i => historyAddress d N i (l γ))
api.allocation: (f : RegisteredF r d) (N : Nat) : Allocation (program f N)
api.history_locate: (f : RegisteredF r d) (N : Nat) (i : Fin d) (l : Fin (N + 1)) : ((allocation f N).locate (historyDefAddr f N i l)).val = ⟨l, i⟩
api.history_place: (f : RegisteredF r d) (N : Nat) (i : Fin d) (l : Fin (N + 1)) : place (allocation f N) (historyAddress d N i l) = .inr ⟨l, i⟩
api.place_injective: (f : RegisteredF r d) (N : Nat) : Function.Injective (place (allocation f N))

integration.history_block: (List.finRange d).map (fun i => historyDefAddr f N i l)
integration.persistent_group: (List.finRange d).map (fun i => (⟨historyDefined f N, persistentOccurrence f N i l⟩ : OccRef (program f N)))
integration.initial_group: (List.finRange d).map (fun i => (⟨historyDefined f N, initialOccurrence f N i⟩ : OccRef (program f N)))
integration.recurrence_group: For k : Fin N, (List.finRange d).map (fun i => (⟨historyDefined f N, recurrenceOccurrence f N i k⟩ : OccRef (program f N))) targets slice k.val + 1.
integration.valuation_note: All three source IDs use d*(N+1) raw valuations. Guards select all (i,l) for persistent X, l=0 for Z, and l<N for recurrence. No Fin division is used, so zero extents are computationally safe.
integration.execution_note: Core/allocation require no algebraic instance because they contain only reads/tab/prim/at. Existing collecting and plan execution machinery imposes AddCommMonoid V and ScalarOps at the usual call sites.
integration.allocation_note: Buffer := Fin (N+1); buffers := List.finRange (N+1); each capacity d, each sort (); H(i,l) maps to buffer l, position i. Input slots remain Sum.inl under existing place.
integration.layout_note: Use existing Plan.layoutOK_of_place_injective with place_injective f N after installing allocation f N on the parent's plan.
